module_summary: Destination half of a 2-phase CDC: synchronizes the toggling async request, captures async data on a request edge, and toggles an ack register when the local valid/ready handshake completes.

anchors.name: data_dst_q
anchors.why: Captures async_data_i on request transition, held until consumed, drives data_o

anchors.name: ack_dst_q
anchors.why: Phase-toggle ack register flipped on each accepted item, drives async_ack_o

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: Valid when synchronized request phase differs from ack phase

anchors.name: ready_i
anchors.why: Downstream ready; with valid_o forms dst_accept to toggle ack

anchors.name: data_o
anchors.why: Synchronous-side data output copied from data_dst_q

anchors.name: req_synced_q1
anchors.why: Delayed synchronized request for edge detection; compared for data load and valid

anchors.name: req_synced
anchors.why: Async request after tc_sync synchronizer, edge triggers data capture

anchors.name: dst_data_load
anchors.why: Load enable for data_dst_q on request transition when not already valid

anchors.name: dst_accept
anchors.why: Accept handshake strobe enabling ack_dst_q toggle

groups.name: req_sync
groups.description: Synchronizes async request and delays it for transition detection

groups.name: data_capture
groups.description: Loads async data on request edge and presents it as data_o

groups.name: ack_handshake
groups.description: Valid/ready handshake toggling 2-phase ack back to the source
